assumptions: Seven nominal 310g RS00 solids with uniform effective-density inertias; internal rotor/transmission inertia unidentified
CNC structural aluminium at2700kg/m3; 6061 alloy provisional

PLA+ fingers42/43 and camera bracket70: nominal solid density1240kg/m3 times user-assumed30%effective solid fraction=372kg/m3; uniform effective-density inertia approximation. Finger loops44/45 physically absent and excluded
All model arm effort limits5Nm nominal datasheet rated, not thermal guarantee; simulation velocity2rad/s is a conservative chosen cap
Cables, omitted fasteners, waterproofing additions and payload not estimated without evidence

J2-J3 and J3-J4 use solid assembly collision envelopes with plate-pair cavities filled; rail base and fingers retain filled-outline envelopes. CAD visuals and measured/estimated mass properties remain separate from collision filling.
Motor axis positive signs inherited from reference convention, physical signs not independently checked
Reference pose is source CAD assembly, not measured encoder zero

collision_geometry.notes: assemblies merge collision geometry within one rigid link, bridge the complete plate spacing, and preserve the exterior profile. A 25 micrometre profile cleanup plus outward margin avoids tiny tessellation notches; the result is clipped to the full 3D convex envelope. Visual CAD meshes and mass properties remain unchanged. outline_parts preserve individual rail/finger outlines while filling holes/grooves. Values in parts are CoACD caps for other brackets. Other parts default to one convex hull.

42.basis: same broad-view PCA projection as comparison image
42.purpose: Preserve the complete outer perimeter, fill projected holes, and bridge depth grooves inside the 3D convex envelope.

43.basis: same broad-view PCA projection as comparison image
43.purpose: Preserve the complete outer perimeter, fill projected holes, and bridge depth grooves inside the 3D convex envelope.

24.basis: same broad-view PCA projection as comparison image
24.purpose: Preserve the complete rail-base outer perimeter and fill every projected internal hole, including the centre opening. Remove sub-micrometre boundary slivers that collapse on the 1 micrometre STL export grid; validate against the unsimplified perimeter.

upper_arm_shell.purpose: One continuous collision envelope for J2-J3: two plates, supports and the enclosed motor. Fill the cavity across the plates while retaining the outer XZ profile.

forearm_shell.purpose: One continuous collision envelope for J3-J4: all four plates, all six cylindrical spacers, supports and the enclosed motor. Fill both plate-pair cavities and the connecting region.

collision_geometry.surface_coverage: Outline parts preserve the filled broad-view CAD projection inside the full 3D convex envelope. Other compounds restore sampled source surface coverage after simplification.
